name: Pirate Borg Ruleset Pack
description: A scurvy-ridden ruleset pack for Pirate Borg — dark Caribbean tabletop RPG with cutlasses, flintlocks, black powder, ash, and nautical doom.

attribution.notice: Pirate Borg is copyright Limithron LLC. Adapted for tabletop play.

conditions.name: Broken
conditions.description: At 0 HP, roll d4: 1=Unconscious d4 rounds, 2=Disabling injury, 3=Hemorrhaging/Dying in d4 rounds, 4=Dead.

conditions.name: Cursed
conditions.description: The black spot or sea witch curse. Disadvantage on all Presence and Spirit checks.

conditions.name: Scurvy
conditions.description: Rotting gums and lethargy. Speed halved and max HP reduced by 2.

conditions.name: Drowning
conditions.description: Cannot breathe or speak; take d6 damage per round unless rescued.

actions.name: Cutlass Strike
actions.description: Melee attack with cutlass or boarding axe (Strength DR12). Deals d6 damage.

actions.name: Flintlock Shot
actions.description: Fire flintlock pistol or blunderbuss (Agility DR12). Deals 2d4 damage; requires 1 round to reload.

actions.name: Rapier Thrust
actions.description: Agility-based melee strike. Deals d8 damage on hit.

actions.name: Use Ancient Relic
actions.description: Channel ancient Caribbean sorcery or sea relic (Presence DR12). Failure triggers Arcane Catastrophe.

actions.name: Fire Ship Cannon
actions.description: Fire 6-pounder or swivel gun. Deals 3d10 damage to ships or massive targets.

actions.name: Spend Devil's Luck
actions.description: Expend 1 Devil's Luck to reroll a test, maximize damage, or negate a critical fumble.

races.name: Buccaneer (Human)
races.description: Hard-bitten survivor of Caribbean port towns and pirate havens.

features.name: Sea Legs
features.description: Immune to seasickness; advantage on checks to maintain balance on pitching decks.

races.name: Haunted / Undead Crew
races.description: Risen from Davy Jones' locker with saltwater in their bones.

features.name: Saltwater Bones
features.description: Does not need to breathe or eat; immune to poison and drowning.

classes.name: Zealot
classes.description: Fanatical preacher wielding burning black powder and holy scripture.

features.name: Wrath of the Heavens
features.description: Test Presence DR12 to smite with holy fire or banish sea ghosts.

classes.name: Sorcerer of the Tide
classes.description: Touched by deep trench abominations and cursed abyssal relics.

features.name: Abyssal Whispers
features.description: Summon fog, command sea vermin, or curse enemy ships.

classes.name: Swashbuckler
classes.description: Acrobatic duel-master swinging from the rigging with steel in both hands.

features.name: Parry & Riposte
features.description: On successful defense test against melee attack, immediately counterattack for d4 damage.

classes.name: Brute
classes.description: Massive cannon-loader and brawler who drinks grog by the gallon.

features.name: Thick Skull
features.description: Ignore 1 point of physical damage from every incoming attack.
